title: [dev] Manual profile switches sent twice to pump
symptom: Manual profile switches are sent twice to the pump. The issue was observed after a recent build, while an older build sent the profile switch only once.
cause: The cause is profile name checking, as indicated by the commit referenced in the comment.
fix: The issue was fixed by commit f48dcc77e23d499ab0c1af8499ce9ce8ed574ba1.
evidence_quote: this is the reason. profile name checking
